codeVersion.description: Working tree with uncommitted changes; commit is a reference only

checks: Two worker processes claim a reminder once, same key deduplicates, and tenant keys remain independent
Provider acceptance with lost response replays the same immutable key without a second delivery
Crash after claim is recovered by another process, and an expired lease cannot renew or finish
Timeout without replay guarantee becomes UNCERTAIN and cannot be reexecuted as a fresh delivery
Provider errors exhaust bounded attempts, expiry prevents calls, and unavailable coordination sends nothing
Pausing one tenant does not starve another; controls and retries require owner, tenant and audit
Idle schedulers create no periodic MAIL rows; retention keeps failures and audit records
A tenant owner cannot pause platform license enforcement; legacy license pauses are ignored
License handler stays inside one tenant and a slow expired owner cannot repeat grace or audit transitions
Outage longer than the license horizon creates a fresh review without repeating transition or audit
Cold scheduler clears the last expired encrypted action without sending or another active action
Immutable mail recipient suppression survives an account email change before retry
Concurrent scheduler cursor pages reach due account actions beyond the first 200 without duplication
Confirmed account task survives HTTP restart; separate actual worker exposes readiness and honest mail state
